title: Tell us what you need
lead: Voice recognition is active and listening automatically. Speak your command to navigate without touching any buttons.
speakPrompt: Speak into your microphone — say “explore schemes” or “find schemes”

fallback.unavailable: Voice input is unavailable. Type a command instead.
fallback.unclear: Speech was unclear. Type a command instead.
fallback.general: You can also type a command
fallback.placeholder: Type a command, for example: explore schemes

hints.application: Say “save pdf”, “back to schemes”, or “go home”

spoken.voiceReady: Voice assistant ready. Say explore schemes to scan your document, or say find schemes.
spoken.scannerReady: Document scanner ready. Position your document. Say find scheme when ready.
spoken.confirmDetails: Check your details {{name}}. Say find scheme to see your welfare schemes, or rescan.
spoken.schemesFound: {{count}} matching schemes found. Say choose scheme 1 for {{first}}, or choose scheme 2.
spoken.noSchemes: No matching schemes found. Say rescan or go back.
spoken.appReview: Application review for {{scheme}}. Say save pdf to generate your application.
spoken.appSubmitted: Application completed. Say save pdf to download your file.
spoken.findingSchemes: Finding matching schemes for your confirmed details.
